content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Gumroad payhip

Gumroad and Payhip are popular choices for selling digital products, offering user-friendly interfaces and integrated payment solutions. However, they restrict access to many countries, leaving creators unable to utilize their services. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructures like COREMERCH provide a fully operational online store framework that eliminates dependence on these traditional platforms. By using technologies such as Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, creators can deploy a robust sales solution that allows them to process payments in cryptocurrency without the risk of account restrictions.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal operate under stringent legal frameworks, limiting their services to only 46 countries. This exclusion forces creators in restricted regions into a corner where they have no feasible payment solution. PayPal, for instance, can suspend accounts, freezing funds for up to 180 days without recourse. In contrast, COREMERCH's sovereign stacks are designed explicitly for creators facing these restrictions, offering a permanent solution that requires no third-party approval or compliance headaches. With full ownership and autonomy, users are free to engage in commerce without fear of sudden service interruptions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment processing, traditional platforms often impose varied fees that can cut into creators' profits. PayPal and Stripe typically charge transaction fees ranging from 2.9% to 4.4%, not including potential currency conversion costs. In stark contrast, NOWPayments offers a straightforward 0.5% fee for processing payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies. This low-cost model, combined with instant payment confirmations, enables creators to receive funds more quickly and retain more revenue from their sales. Ultimately, utilizing sovereign infrastructure translates to better financial outcomes for creators.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you full control over your digital sales.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the most critical factors for creators is ownership of their digital products and data. Platforms like Gumroad and Payhip typically retain control over user accounts and product listings, which can lead to frustrating situations if accounts are suspended. On the other hand, COREMERCH's architecture ensures that once a stack is deployed, the creator maintains full ownership with no strings attached. Automation features streamline order management and product delivery, allowing creators to focus on their work instead of administrative tasks. This level of ownership and autonomy is non-negotiable for serious digital entrepreneurs.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on the scale of your digital products and your specific needs. For creators looking for a quick setup, the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) is an excellent option, enabling deployment within 48 hours. However, for those who require more robust features, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is ideal, offering five product uploads, comprehensive testing, and full configuration of email protocols. By aligning your choice with your product range and business goals, you can ensure a seamless commerce experience tailored to your situation.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Avoid account suspensions and frozen funds with traditional payment platforms.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Start by assessing your digital product offerings to determine the necessary features. Then, select the COREMERCH stack that suits your needs, like the Edge Commerce Stack. Next, set up your account on Cloudflare and configure your store using provided documentation. Integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing and ensure your files are stored securely. Finally, launch your store and begin promoting your products.
